text.arabic_uthmani: أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: disjunctive continuation opening a second maritime outcome, with the previous branch still required for scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causes them to perish or be wrecked

words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) opens this ayah as an unfinished alternative, not as a fresh scene. It reaches back to the ship outcome in 42:33 and lets {{ar:يُوبِقْهُنَّ}} ({{tr:yūbiqhunna}}) specify a harsher branch, so the ayah break itself sits inside one continuing maritime sequence. Its short sound also makes the turn into the heavy destruction verb feel abrupt.

topics.headline: alternative branch inside one ship sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destruction clause is one possible handling of the same ships, not a new subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a disjunctive particle introducing an alternative verbal outcome in the preceding maritime sequence.

topics.headline: opening word carries the prior branch across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins in grammatical dependence on 42:33, so the boundary does not reset the scene.
topics.reason: The clause begins with a disjunctive particle whose concrete alternative is supplied by the preceding ship branch.

topics.headline: brief particle snaps into the wreck verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the alternative as a quick turn into pending peril before the longer verb unfolds.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the imperfect destruction verb and functions as a compact launch into the alternative outcome.

words.gloss_range: causative threatened wrecking or ruin of the vessels, prospective in the alternative branch and grounded by the following causal phrase
words.root_gloss_range: ruin, perishing, causing to perish, being trapped toward destruction, and barrier-like separation; the local Form IV selects caused ruin of the vessels

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: feminine plural object suffix referring to the vessels
because of or through what they earned

words.prose: {{ar:يُوبِقْهُنَّ}} ({{tr:yūbiqhunna}}) makes the alternative concrete as caused ruin, not a neutral sea accident. The Form IV verb keeps the divine actor active, while the attached {{ar:هُنَّ}} ({{tr:hunna}}) carries the same ships forward from 42:33 as the object, and its nasal ending keeps those vessels audible inside the verb. The following {{ar:بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:bi-mā kasabū}}) splits the roles sharply: people have earned, but the vessels are the visible site where that liability could land. The rare {{ar:و ب ق}} ({{tr:w-b-q}}) field also lets the wreck feel like perdition or inescapable loss, with 18:52 supplying a contrastive ruin-field rather than a replacement for the local verb.

topics.headline: prospective caused ruin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ships do not simply perish; ruin is presented as a possible caused divine action.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV with an implicit divine subject and clitic object; V4 includes caused perishing under the accepted ruin branch.

topics.headline: ships suffer what human agents earned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mediated consequence: human earners and affected vessels are grammatically distinct.
topics.reason: The object suffix on the verb is feminine plural for the vessels, while {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabū}}) supplies masculine plural human agents.

topics.headline: wreck tied to earned cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possible wreck is immediately explained as accountable consequence.
topics.reason: The {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}) phrase is attached to the destruction verb as its causal ground.

topics.headline: rare ruin field colors the ship peril
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threat sounds like perdition or ruinous loss, not routine maritime damage.
topics.reason: The root is low-occurrence locally and V4 supports ruin/perishing, while 18:52 remains a contrastive root-field parallel rather than the local sense.

topics.headline: nasal suffix keeps the ships audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the affected ships held inside the verb through the attached suffix.
topics.reason: The clitic object is syntactically forced and remains fused to the verb in the recited surface.

topics.headline: stilled ships become possible wrecked ships
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same vessels carried from 42:33 into a more severe possible outcome.
topics.reason: The suffix points back to the vessels, and the opening alternative keeps this branch within the prior maritime sign-frame.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition binding the relative phrase as causal ground and means for the threatened wreck
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) does the work of attaching accountability to the wreck verb. As part of {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}), it turns what follows into the ground, and also the channel, through which earned action reaches the ships. The bound unit is compact before the earning verb expands the responsibility. Because the phrase stands before the pardon clause, liability is established before remission arrives as a counterweight.

topics.headline: cause attached to the wreck verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wreck is grammatically tied to what was earned, not left as blind weather or isolated peril.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) the governed complement of {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and the causal ground for the destruction verb.

topics.headline: cause also feels like a medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earned action is not only the reason for consequence but the route by which consequence reaches the vessels.
topics.reason: The local support allows causal ground, and the preposition's by/because-of range can be retained without turning it into a separate instrument.

topics.headline: bound phrase compresses cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters cause as a compact bound unit before the earning verb expands it.
topics.reason: The preposition is a prefixed segment of the fused surface {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}).

topics.headline: cause phrase precedes the remission clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accountability is named before the ayah turns to pardon.
topics.reason: The causal phrase directly follows the destruction verb and comes before the coordinated pardon clause.

words.gloss_range: relative what, governed by the prefixed preposition and completed by the earning verb as a broad causal object
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is relative, not negative. It opens a governed slot that {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabū}}) completes, so the cause is "what they earned" without listing offenses, gains, penalties, or liabilities. Its openness lets the phrase carry both the acquired object and the act of acquisition while remaining bound inside the causal {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}).

topics.headline: relative slot completed by earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word opens the cause and waits for the earning verb to fill it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and completed by the relative clause {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabū}}).

topics.headline: unstated earned content remains broad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cause is broad enough to include deeds, gains, incurred penalties, or liability without itemizing them.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun supplies an open object for the earning verb, and no explicit lexical object narrows the content.

topics.headline: bound phrase allows object or verbal-noun construal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase can be heard as because of what they earned or because of their earning, both under causal government.
topics.reason: The surface is part of the governed compound {{ar:بِمَا}} ({{tr:bi-mā}}), which keeps the broad reference inside causal scope.

words.gloss_range: they earned, gained, or incurred, with the local context selecting acquired liability as the causal content
words.root_gloss_range: earning, acquiring, seeking gain or livelihood, causing another to gain, and minor nonlocal nominal branches; the local Form I perfect selects direct human acquisition or incurred liability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causes them to perish or be wrecked

words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabū}}) supplies the human agents without naming them as a noun. Its masculine plural ending keeps them distinct from the feminine ship object, and the perfect form places accrued liability beneath the still-pending wreck. The root's gain/acquisition field is narrowed here by the ruin clause: what they have acquired functions as blame or liability. Form I keeps that acquisition direct and broad, without a derivational buffer that would shift responsibility elsewhere. The same pattern recalls the earning-and-affliction principle of 42:30 and immediately prepares the turn to {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}), so completed human earning flows into compact pardon rather than becoming the ayah's final word. Across the boundary, this active acquisition also contrasts with the earlier posture of receptive response.

topics.headline: masculine plural agents are not the ships
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that people are the earners while the ships are the affected object.
topics.reason: The verb carries masculine plural subject agreement, while the destruction verb has a feminine plural object suffix for the vessels.

topics.headline: past earning under pending peril
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accrued human action is placed before the possible divine wrecking.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as Form I perfect, while the preceding wreck verb is imperfect in the alternative branch.

topics.headline: earning takes broad relative object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gain-language has become liability-language because the earned object grounds possible ruin.
topics.reason: The object is the open relative {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}); V4 supports earning/acquiring, and the local context selects acquired liability.

topics.headline: Form I keeps acquisition direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that responsibility is not shifted through an added derivational buffer; the local form leaves earning broad and direct.
topics.reason: The local form is simple Form I perfect; comparison with other derivations is useful only as a contrast, not as active local morphology.

topics.headline: 42:30 principle returns in the ship scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 42:34 turns the affliction, earning, and pardon rule of 42:30 into a concrete maritime case.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah references, and contextual profiles support the earning/pardon association.

topics.headline: earned cause pivots toward pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earning clause is the middle hinge between visible peril and withheld enforcement.
topics.reason: The relative clause completes the causal phrase before the coordinated pardon clause begins.

topics.headline: sound and boundary carry the turn from earning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears completed human earning flow into compact pardon and sees active acquisition contrasted with earlier receptive response.
topics.reason: The row-level sound and boundary observations are coherent with the local sequence and do not alter the parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating and counterweighting conjunction prefixed to the pardon verb after the earned-cause clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let the ayah close at earned wreckage. It coordinates the possible destruction with {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}), and because it is fused to the pardon verb, remission enters immediately after the causal phrase. The fused turn also makes the move from earning to pardon feel connected rather than like a hard restart. The conjunction is still bare coordination, but in this position it feels like a counterweight: and, while, almost yet.

topics.headline: destruction and pardon are structurally paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon is paired with potential destruction rather than added as detached commentary.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}) with {{ar:يُوبِقْهُنَّ}} ({{tr:yūbiqhunna}}) as another divine action.

topics.headline: pardon reopens the frame after cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earned causality is real but is immediately met by remission.
topics.reason: The conjunction follows the causal phrase and introduces the final pardon clause.

topics.headline: coordination gains near-contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses a contrastive turn without replacing the conjunction with an explicit adversative particle.
topics.reason: The surface particle remains bare coordination; the contrastive value comes from pardon following earned destruction.

topics.headline: proclitic and liaison smooth the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the move from earning to pardon as connected rather than as a hard restart.
topics.reason: The conjunction is prefixed directly to the pardon verb in the surface form.

words.gloss_range: he pardons, passes over, or remits, with claims turned away from enforcement through the following prepositional complement
words.root_gloss_range: pardon, leaving punishment, wiping away guilt, turning harm away, surplus left unclaimed, effacement, and increase; the local verb selects remission/passing over with effacement pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}) shifts the ayah from accountable cause to remitted consequence. Its hidden 3ms subject continues the same divine actor who could wreck the ships, so destruction and pardon are held under one agency. The clipped base form makes the pardon beat compact after the heavier threat, while fuller variants expose that cadence without changing the local relation. With {{ar:عَن كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿan kathīrin}}), the verb is not a vague feeling of lenience; it directs claims away from a broad domain. As Form I, it presents direct pardon while the {{ar:ع ف و}} ({{tr:ʿ-f-w}}) field keeps pardon and effacement together. The exact phrase echoes 42:30 and turns the ship peril into a reprise of the surah's larger rule: earned liability is real, but much is withheld from enforcement.

topics.headline: pardon governs a broad remitted domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon is directed toward a domain of claims, not left as an unspecified emotion.
topics.reason: The verb governs {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}), and contextual data show this preposition as the top profile for the form.

topics.headline: clipped base reading made visible by variants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the base verb as compact after the heavier threat, while fuller variants expose cadence rather than changing the local relation.
topics.reason: The local surface is the shortened imperfect; variant rows are useful as acoustic contrast but do not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: same actor can wreck and pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same implied divine subject holds both possible wrecking and pardon together.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the implicit 3ms subject to the same divine-action chain.

topics.headline: pardon includes effacement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon works as removal or turning away of claims, not merely kindly feeling.
topics.reason: V4 supports leaving punishment and wiping away guilt; broader branches such as untouched land or young animals are not activated locally.

topics.headline: Form I presents direct remission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices direct pardon with root-field effacement pressure, without importing an intensive form as the local morphology.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the local verb as Form I; derivational family rows survive as pressure but not as active form replacement.

topics.headline: 42:30 pardon-over-much formula returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ship scene repeats the pardon-over-much ending of 42:30.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and the contextual profile supports the {{ar:ع ف و}} ({{tr:ʿ-f-w}}) plus {{ar:ك ث ر}} ({{tr:k-th-r}}) association.

topics.headline: earning and pardon form a counter-movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pardon answers established liability immediately, reframing visible wreck as only one possible enforcement.
topics.reason: The pardon clause follows the earned-cause clause and is coordinated as the final counterweight beat.

topics.headline: pardon prepares abundant remission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remission is not minimal; the verb opens toward an abundant waived domain.
topics.reason: The local phrase governs {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}), and contextual co-occurrence links pardon with abundance.

words.gloss_range: preposition governed by the pardon verb, marking the domain from or concerning which claim is lifted
words.prose: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) turns pardon into a directed relation. After {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}), it marks the field from which claim is lifted, and only after this preposition does {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}) arrive as the broad remitted domain. Its separation value makes forgiveness feel spatial and practical, while its nasal sound binds into the final tanwīn.

topics.headline: preposition marks the remitted domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that much is the governed field from which enforcement is turned away, not a new actor or free adverbial.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}) the prepositional complement governed by {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) after the pardon verb.

topics.headline: away-from and concerning both serve pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pardon as movement away from enforceable burden and as action concerning a defined domain.
topics.reason: The local construction with {{ar:يَعْفُ}} ({{tr:yaʿfu}}) licenses the preposition as the remitted domain, preserving the spatial separation pressure.

topics.headline: preposition delays and opens the scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels remission open outward when the complement is completed by the final word.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement follows the verb and is completed only by the final indefinite adjective.

topics.headline: nasal sound binds the closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition acoustically bound to the final remitted abundance.
topics.reason: The sound note is local to the recited sequence and reinforces the grammatically governed link.

words.gloss_range: much or many as an indefinite substantive under the preposition, leaving the remitted domain large and unspecified
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, manyness, increase, outnumbering, rivalry in abundance, and specialized nonlocal nouns; the local adjective selects open-ended quantity
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:kathīrin}}) closes the ayah on unmeasured pardon. It stands substantively under {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}), with no counted noun to say whether the much consists of deeds, penalties, effects, persons, or claims. The indefinite form and tanwīn keep the domain open, while the {{ar:ك ث ر}} ({{tr:k-th-r}}) field supplies real abundance pressure. Because the same ending repeats 42:30, the maritime case becomes a local refrain: visible consequence is smaller than the waived field. The final abundance therefore belongs to the same earning-and-pardon field, not to decorative scale alone.

topics.headline: adjective stands for an unstated domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word leaves the remitted domain broad instead of naming a single category.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite qualitative adjective functioning substantively as the complement of {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}).

topics.headline: much is governed, not independent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that much is precisely the field from which pardon turns away claim.
topics.reason: The final word is governed by {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) as a genitive prepositional complement.

topics.headline: abundance, not itemized counting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices scale as the point of the final word: pardon is quantitatively expansive without becoming an itemized list.
topics.reason: V4 supports abundance and numerical increase; specialized branches such as rivalry, dust, or palm pith do not replace the local adjective.

topics.headline: indefinite ending keeps pardon open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the final domain as open-ended through indefiniteness and tanwīn.
topics.reason: The noun instance is indefinite with no article or stated counted noun, and the recited ending preserves that openness.

topics.headline: 42:30 ending returns as a refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's final abundance repeats 42:30 rather than functioning as a one-off scale word.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide the concrete 42:30 echo, and contextual profiles show {{ar:ك ث ر}} ({{tr:k-th-r}}) frequently serving as a prepositional complement.

topics.headline: final word generalizes the ship event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah with a rule of consequence management: what is waived is larger than what is visibly enforced.
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah and completes the coordinated pardon clause after the ship-destruction alternative.

topics.headline: abundance links earning and pardon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final abundance as part of the same field as earned liability and remission, not decorative scale.
topics.reason: Contextual co-occurrence supports links among earning, pardon, and abundance in the local sequence.

topics.headline: nasal sound seals the closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final openness as an acoustic closure bound to the preceding preposition.
topics.reason: The nasalized final ending coheres with the immediately preceding {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:ʿan}}) while reinforcing the semantic openness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast joins يُوبِقْهُنَّ, بِمَا كَسَبُوا, and وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ in one causal alternative.
baseline_models.mechanism: Self-directed acquisition makes conduct accrue to its agents; the causative ruin realizes that accrual, while pardon relinquishes punishment attached to a large remainder. Ruin and remission are therefore two asymmetrical dispositions of earned liability, not unrelated events.

activation_trace.role: Ruin includes both falling into destruction and causing another to fall into it, supplying the terminal consequence of the mechanism.
Acquiring benefit for oneself supplies the reflexive accrual pattern, here redirected from gain to responsibility for what one has made one's own.
Leaving deserved punishment and effacing fault supplies the counter-disposition to realized ruin.
Numerical abundance makes remission extensive without requiring the verse to deny the earned basis of liability.

changed_reading.before: The line merely alternates between destroying some and pardoning many.
changed_reading.after: The line stages selective accountability: acquired conduct can be made causally terminal, yet punishment connected with a large remainder is actively relinquished.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُوبِقْهُنَّ can activate the root's confinement branch while remaining governed by بِمَا كَسَبُوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative verb can describe holding the feminine plural referents fast in a condition from which they cannot free themselves, with destruction as the outcome rather than necessarily the first instant. Pardon is then not only legal cancellation but warding off the harmful condition.

activation_trace.role: Being stuck and confined without release supplies a process of immobilization that tends toward ruin.
What agents acquire supplies the condition that catches up with and holds them.
Warding off harm and clothing in safety supplies release from the destructive condition, not merely cancellation after it.

changed_reading.before: يُوبِقْهُنَّ denotes an immediate act of destruction.
changed_reading.after: يُوبِقْهُنَّ may foreground being caught and held until ruin, while وَيَعْفُ names protection from that trajectory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of يَعْفُ and كَثِيرٍ activates two internal ع ف و branches: loss of trace and increase in what is left alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pardon can be imagined as weathering away an actionable trace; at the same time, what is left uncut or unclaimed can grow numerous. The construction therefore permits a dynamic image in which non-enforcement both removes many traces and leaves an abundant remainder.

activation_trace.role: The disappearance of a track or dwelling's trace supplies active de-tracing of liability.
Growth and increase when something is left alone supplies the productive side of non-enforcement.
Increase in number turns the result of leaving alone into an abundant remainder.

changed_reading.before: Pardon is a static decision not to punish a fixed quantity.
changed_reading.after: Pardon can be pictured as removing the trace by which liability is pursued while allowing what is spared to become abundant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact earning-and-pardon clause of 42:30 is repeated in the focus after generic affliction has been replaced by a specific causative ruin. The focus thus embodies the earlier moral equation in a concrete affected medium: earned action can return as an event that strikes and immobilizes, while the same remission clause interrupts that return for much.

activation_trace.role: A calamity that alights on a person supplies the generic consequence frame later specified by يُوبِقْهُنَّ.
Self-acquired action supplies the repeated causal hinge shared with the focus.
The explicit image of what the two hands earn locates agency in enacted conduct rather than abstract fate.
Relinquishing deserved punishment supplies the verbatim counterforce repeated in the focus.
Abundance supplies the unchanged scope marker of remission.
Causative ruin converts the earlier generic affliction into a terminally specified consequence.

structural_cues: 42:30 and 42:34 repeat بِمَا كَسَبَتْ/كَسَبُوا وَيَعْفُوا/يَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ with only number, inflection, and the preceding consequence predicate changed.
The repeated clause occurs before the focus, so it supplies a general rule that the focus can instantiate rather than a later gloss imposed on it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, hand-agency, and a generic calamity; I infer that the focus concretizes that rule in its feminine plural referents. A live alternative is emphatic repetition without a deliberate general-to-specific mapping.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a locally isolated destructive possibility.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a concrete instantiation of the surah's earlier rule that enacted acquisition can return as affliction, with extensive remission built into the same causal frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence progressively removes mobility: moving vessels, wind made still, vessels fixed after motion, entrapment tending to ruin, then no deviation or escape. This sharpens the confinement baseline into a temporal mechanism in which loss of propulsion becomes loss of steerage, exposure, and finally destruction.

activation_trace.role: Flowing and running supply the initial state of active maritime movement.
The branch's explicit stabilization of a vessel by its steering apparatus sharpens stilling as loss of steerable motion.
Wind and moving air supply the external propulsive medium whose withdrawal starts the sequence.
Fixity after prior movement supplies the intermediate state between travel and destructive confinement.
Inescapable sticking and detention supply the terminal intensification of the preceding stillness.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape maneuver that the following negation removes.

structural_cues: 42:32-35 forms an uninterrupted sequence around the focus: vessels move, wind stops, vessels remain motionless, ruin is possible, and disputers have no escape.
The feminine plural suffix in the focus resolves naturally against the immediately preceding vessels only after context is revealed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered motion states and a no-escape endpoint; I infer a causal progression from propulsion loss through confinement to ruin. A live alternative is that the alternatives are instantaneous divine acts rather than stages in one physical process.

changed_reading.before: يُوبِقْهُنَّ is simply a synonym for sinking the vessels.
changed_reading.after: يُوبِقْهُنَّ is the terminal stage of controlled mobility withdrawal: the vessels can be held fast and exposed until stillness becomes ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, action is cultivated as a harvest, acquired as one's own, made to adhere like a covering, and then falls back upon its agents. The focus's بِمَا كَسَبُوا therefore describes not only past blame but a produced yield whose maturation can take the form of ruin; pardon withholds much of that yield from realization.

activation_trace.role: Gathering, earning, and work supply the productive labor behind the surah's repeated harvest image.
Sowing seed and cultivating supply the temporal arrow from action to a later yield.
Self-acquisition supplies ownership of the yield that the agents fear.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the return of acquired consequence onto its acquirers.
Acquisition that clothes or adheres to its agent supplies the persistent attachment between deed and doer.
The focus anchor names the acquired yield whose consequence may be realized.
Causative ruin supplies the possible terminal yield.

structural_cues: 42:20 develops two harvests, 42:22 says what was earned is falling upon its agents, and 42:23 uses another acquisition verb before the focus repeats كسب.
The sequence preserves both beneficial and destructive yields, so acquisition itself is morally open while its object and result differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harvest, acquisition, adhesion, and falling; I infer a cultivation-to-return mechanism for بِمَا كَسَبُوا. The live alternative is a conventional recompense formula without a sustained material metaphor.

changed_reading.before: What they earned is only a retrospective reason for punishment.
changed_reading.after: What they earned is a cultivated and adhering yield that can ripen into the ruin named by يُوبِقْهُنَّ, while pardon prevents much of that yield from landing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective covering, explicit erasure, and pardon directed at bad acts converge on an active interruption of consequence. In the focus, وَيَعْفُ can therefore mean that many actionable traces are covered, effaced, or released before earned conduct reaches the ruin-predicate.

activation_trace.role: Covering fault while protecting its bearer from the fault's effect supplies an early model of consequence-blocking mercy.
Removal of an existing trace supplies the surah's explicit erasure operation.
Relinquishing punishment is explicitly directed at bad acts, fixing an actionable object for pardon.
What causes harm supplies the class of acts whose downstream effect is interrupted.
Effacement of tracks supplies the focus's strongest process image for breaking the deed-to-consequence link.
Ruin supplies the endpoint that active pardon prevents many traces from reaching.

structural_cues: The mercy vocabulary progresses from protective covering in 42:5 to erasing falsehood in 42:24 and pardoning bad acts in 42:25 before returning in the focus.
42:25 pairs pardon with knowledge of what people do, so remission is represented as informed rather than as failure to register conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, erasure, bad acts, and pardon; I infer that pardon interrupts the causal trace connecting acquisition to ruin. A live alternative is purely forensic cancellation after the deed remains fully traceable.

changed_reading.before: Pardon merely declines to execute a sentence already fixed.
changed_reading.after: Pardon actively de-traces many liabilities, breaking their route from acquired act to destructive realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later justice sequence authorizes response to aggression and exact equivalence, then introduces pardon joined to repair while preserving liability for aggressors. This prevents the focus's وَيَعْفُ from becoming indiscriminate impunity: ruin remains proportionate to acquisition, whereas pardon is a constructive surplus beyond what equivalence permits.

activation_trace.role: Transgression beyond the limit supplies the injury that can legitimately call forth response.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the baseline of reciprocal justice.
Exact likeness supplies the ceiling of proportionate retaliation.
Relinquishing deserved punishment supplies a voluntary move beyond strict equivalence.
Removing estrangement between people makes pardon constructive repair rather than passive non-response.
Acquired conduct anchors destructive consequence in agency rather than arbitrary force.
The focus pardon is revised by the later coupling of relinquishment with repair.

structural_cues: 42:39-43 orders self-defense, equivalent response, pardon with repair, liability for aggressors, and patient forgiveness without collapsing these options.
The focus itself coordinates destructive consequence and pardon rather than replacing the former with the latter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized response, exact equivalence, pardon, and repair; I infer that focus-pardon is an elective constructive surplus within justice. A live alternative is that the later sequence concerns only interpersonal ethics and does not specify the divine alternative in 42:34.

changed_reading.before: Destruction is justice and pardon is its simple negation.
changed_reading.after: Destruction can realize earned liability, while pardon exceeds equivalence toward repair without erasing the distinction between victim, aggressor, and accountable act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branches for leaving alive and for sparing through pardon activate the possibility that كَثِيرٍ ranges over affected beings, not only over offenses. The focus alternative can therefore mean that some may be ruined for what was earned while many are kept alive or unharmed; the familiar reading in which many deeds are forgiven remains simultaneously available.

activation_trace.role: Preserving life and refraining from killing supply an early positive counterpart to destructive power.
Sparing as an act of pardon supplies a lexical bridge between remission and continued existence.
Causing the feminine plural referents to perish supplies one side of the affected-group contrast.
Warding off calamity and granting safety supplies preservation on the other side.
A numerous quantity permits the spared population, as well as forgiven acts, to be large.

structural_cues: The object after كَثِيرٍ is not lexically stated in the focus, leaving deeds, persons, or affected referents as live scopes.
The focus first marks a feminine plural object on يُوبِقْهُنَّ and then leaves the object of pardon implicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies life-preservation, sparing-as-pardon, and an omitted noun after كَثِيرٍ; I infer possible scope over affected beings. The materially live alternative, and likely default, is scope over many offenses or consequences.

changed_reading.before: He destroys the referents but forgives many of their deeds.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that reading, the alternatives may distribute outcomes across the affected group: some are brought to ruin, while many are spared and kept safe.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly alternates expansion with measured restriction: provision is spread or narrowed, unchecked abundance can produce transgression, and mercy is spread after constriction. With ع ف و's focus branch of growth when left alone beside كَثِير, pardon can be read as a calibrated release that allows an abundant remainder rather than merely an exception after punishment.

activation_trace.role: Expansion, increase, and surplus supply the opening pole of providential distribution.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the counter-pole of restraint.
Exceeding the limit through wrongdoing supplies the stated risk of indiscriminate expansion.
Deliberate measured ordering supplies the regulator between release and destructive excess.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the renewed expansion of mercy after constriction.
Tender mercy identifies the quality being spread rather than mere material abundance.
Increase when something is left alone lets pardon function as productive release.
Numerical growth supplies the abundant result of that release.

structural_cues: 42:12 and 42:27 repeat expansion and measured restriction; 42:28 immediately reverses despair through spreading mercy.
The focus places extensive pardon inside a set of controlled alternatives rather than presenting it as an unconditioned universal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expansion, constriction, transgression risk, measured ordering, and spreading mercy; I infer a regulatory release mechanism for pardon. A live alternative is that these are distinct domains whose shared expansion vocabulary should not be mechanized together.

changed_reading.before: Pardoning much is only a large numerical exception to destructive judgment.
changed_reading.after: Pardoning much can function as a measured unbinding that leaves room for abundance, coordinated with rather than external to the surah's economy of restraint and release.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because يُوبِقْ normally carries terminal ruin, but the focus inventory explicitly preserves barrier and inescapable detention, while later no-return, no-refuge, and veil branches reinforce blocked access. It remains anchored in the focus verb, but downstream prose should present barriered transit as a process image leading to ruin, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The B001 and B003 branches of و ب ق let يُوبِقْهُنَّ evoke both an interposed barrier and detention from which release fails.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between two sides supplies obstruction of passage as an internal focus-root image.
Detention without self-release turns obstruction into a condition that can culminate in ruin.
Turning back, repelling, and preventing supply the denied return route.
Taking refuge supplies the shelter that the verse explicitly says is unavailable.
Prevention of access supplies a later explicit barrier mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verb names only the instant at which the vessels are destroyed.
changed_reading.after: The verb may also picture their passage being barred and their movement held without refuge until obstruction becomes ruin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because the packet's surface scene concerns wind and vessels, not organismal death. It remains anchored through the split life/wind inventory of ر و ح, the ordered stillness cues, and the focus confinement branch. Downstream prose should mark the vessels' borrowed breath as personifying analogy, never as a claim that رِيح literally means soul here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's trapped-until-ruin branch follows immediately after wind is stilled and the feminine plural referents become motionless.

activation_trace.role: Moving air supplies the vessels' literal source of propulsion.
Life-bearing breath supplies the analogical image of propulsion as borrowed animation.
Loss of motion supplies the first visible effect of withdrawn animation.
Fixed stillness after movement supplies a quasi-death state before terminal ruin.
Quiescence and extinguished activity broaden death imagery beyond immediate bodily extinction.
Confinement tending toward destruction supplies the transition from suspended motion to fatal outcome.

changed_reading.before: Stopping the wind is merely one weather condition before an unrelated destructive option.
changed_reading.after: The wind can analogically function as the vessels' borrowed breath: its withdrawal produces suspended animation, and يُوبِقْهُنَّ can carry that stillness into ruin.

strongest_changes: The exact 42:30 recurrence turns the focus from an isolated maritime threat into a concrete realization of the surah's general earned-affliction rule.
The 42:32-35 sequence changes يُوبِقْهُنَّ from an instantaneous sinking gloss into the endpoint of propulsion loss, fixed stillness, entrapment, and no escape.
The wider mercy sequence changes pardon from passive non-enforcement into protective covering, de-tracing, and constructive repair beyond exact equivalence.
Life-preservation and sparing branches keep open a second scope for كَثِيرٍ: many affected beings may be spared, alongside the stronger reading that many deeds or consequences are forgiven.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made two structures unusually productive: the verbatim earning-and-pardon template at 42:30, and the immediate motion-control frame around 42:34. Later proportional-justice verses then constrained the mercy activation so that pardon remained compatible with agency, redress, and repair rather than becoming blanket impunity.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only baseline cannot identify the feminine plural referents; their resolution as vessels depends on the preceding context.
The omitted noun after كَثِيرٍ leaves the relative scopes of deeds, consequences, persons, and vessels unresolved.
The productive-release reading from ع ف و B007 and the borrowed-breath analogy are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should stay exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Acquired acts can turn suspended vessels into inescapable ruin, yet pardon leaves many afloat.** Lexical evidence: و ب ق `B002` (causing to perish) and `B003` (caught fast), ك س ب `B001` (acquiring), ع ف و `B001` (leaving punishment) and `B002` (protecting from harm), and ك ث ر `B001` (many). Structural cue and role: ruin is attributed to acquisition, then the same compact pattern as 42:30 interrupts consequence with pardon. Abductive move: I infer that the sea scene materializes moral exposure: once motion is disabled, no onboard capacity guarantees release. Reading change: pardon appears as active preservation amid deserved vulnerability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:40's pairing of pardon with repair corrected a merely subtractive reading here: waived ruin is oriented toward restored soundness, not just survival.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Earned action can trap the vessel before ruin completes.** **Lexical evidence:** و ب ق `B003` (caught fast and unable to get free), with `B002` (falling into ruin), and ك س ب `B001` (acquiring gain), anchored in يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟. **Structural cue:** 42:32-33 move from sailing to arrested ships; 42:35 says there is no turning-place; 42:39 later names oppression that "hits" its recipients. **Assigned role:** the caught-fast branch supplies the intermediate state in which acquired action removes maneuverability and ruin follows. **Abductive move:** I infer that destruction is mediated by entrapment rather than an unstructured strike. **Reading change:** يُوبِقْهُنَّ depicts consequence as becoming stuck in what was acquired.
2. **Pardon is the counterforce that releases many liabilities.** **Lexical evidence:** ع ف و `B001` (leaving punishment and wiping guilt) and ك ث ر `B001` (abundance), anchored in وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ. **Structural cue:** the phrase repeats 42:30 inside a concrete destruction scenario; 42:37 and 42:40 will transfer forgiveness into human conflict. **Assigned role:** pardon prevents many acquisitions from fastening into destructive entrapment. **Abductive move:** I infer release from the contrast with `B003`; the ayah states non-enforcement but not an unfastening image. **Reading change:** pardon is systemic interruption of liability, not an incidental exception.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:35's مَّحِيص confirmed the caught-fast branch of و ب ق. 42:37's forgiveness and 42:39's redress then clarified that pardon can release liability without denying the harmed party's agency.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi ayak basılmamış ve sahiplenilmemiş yer ile uğranıp bulandırılmamış suyu destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki dokunulmamış yemek, ayrı bir sözlük biriminde bulunsa da dal düzeyindeki kaynak iddiasına eklenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tanımı yalnızca verilen yer ve su yapılarına bağlıdır; dokunulmamış yemek yalnızca kendi sözlük biriminin karşılığında korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yer ve suyla kurulan belirtilmiş yapılarda geçerlidir; çıplak köke genel bir dokunulmamışlık anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Verilen yer ve su yapılarında, daha önce ayak basılmamış, sahiplenilmemiş, kullanılmamış veya bulandırılmamış olma durumudur.

facets.statement: Yer için ayak basılmamış, kullanım izi taşımayan ve kimsenin mülkü olmayan alanı anlatır.
Su için uğranmamış ve içine girilerek bulandırılmamış durumda kalmayı anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak iddiası, kimsenin ayak basmadığı ve mülk izi bırakmadığı yeri, ayrıca uğranıp bulandırılmamış suyu ortak el değmemişlik sınırında birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toz ve harap oluşu, rüzgârın yapı ile izleri silmesini ve yerin zamanla yok oluşa yönelmesini aynı sonradan aşınma sürecinde birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, hiç kullanılmamış bir yerin izsizliğini değil, önceden var olan yerin veya izin aşınıp silinmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel silinip harap olma durumu ile rüzgârın izleri silmesi ve kötü dilek yapısı birbirinden ayrılır; yapı içi anlamlar genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerin veya izlerin zamanla aşınıp silinmesi, rüzgârın izleri yok etmesi ve geride toz ya da yıkıntı kalmasıdır.

facets.statement: Önceden var olan yerin veya izin aşınıp görünmez duruma gelmesi çekirdektir.
Rüzgârın yapı ve izleri silmesi sürecin belirgin etkenli gerçekleşmesidir.
Toz, harap oluş ve yok oluş, silinme sürecinin adlaşmış sonuç alanını oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yapı ve izlerin özellikle rüzgârla aşınıp silinmesini; toz, harap oluş ve yok olmayı bu sürecin sonuçları olarak birlikte sunar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi saç, tüy, telek, bitki ve topluluğun büyüyüp çoğalmasını, ayrıca bilgide başkasını aşmayı destekler. Bir şeyi bırakma koşulu ise bütün bu kullanımlar için ortak ve zorunlu bir koşul değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bırakılınca gürleşme yalnızca ilgili sözlük birimlerinde korunur; etlenme ve vermede artış da dal düzeyindeki çekirdeğe eklenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel büyüme ve çoğalma, saç ile bitkiye bağlı yapılar ve birini bilgide aşma yapısı ayrı yüzlerdir; bırakma koşulu yalnızca onu taşıyan birimlerde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Saç, tüy, telek, bitki veya topluluğun büyüyüp çoğalması ve bilgi bakımından birini aşacak ölçüde artmadır.

facets.statement: Canlı örtünün, bitkinin veya topluluğun büyüyüp çoğalması temel nicelik değişimidir.
Tüy ve teleğin gür ve sık duruma gelmesi bu büyümenin somut görünümüdür.
Bilgi bakımından bir başkasını aşmak, nicelik artışının soyut alandaki uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar saç, tüy, telek, bitki ve insanların büyüyüp çoğalmasını ortak artış çekirdeğinde birleştirir ve bu çekirdeği bilgide başkasını aşmaya genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: büyüyüp çoğalma veya bir ölçüde başkasını aşma
concept_gloss.applicability: Somut gürleşme ile topluluk artışını ve bilgide üstün gelme uzantısını birlikte kapsayan dal karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Somut büyümeyi, nicelikçe çoğalmayı ve karşılaştırmalı artışı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saç, tüy, telek veya bitkinin büyüyüp sıklaştığı somut bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Toplulukların sayıca çoğalmasını ve bilgide başkasını aşma uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlamdan çok, belirli kişi ve durum kalıplarında malı veya sözü çok olma, üzerinde çok sayıda istek ya da hak bulunma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme kullanımlarını toplar. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar ortak bir yalın kök anlamı gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her anlam kendi kalıbına bağlıdır; mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, çok sayıda istemle karşılaşma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme birbirinin yerine geçmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen kişi ve durum kalıplarının anlam alanını düzenler; bunlardan bağımsız bir yalın çokluk anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişinin malının ya da sözünün çok olması, kendisinden iyilik isteyenlerin veya üzerindeki hakların çoğalması yahut başkasının malıyla kendini varlıklı göstermesidir. Bu kullanımlar yalnız bağlı oldukları kalıp içinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Belirli kişi ve durum kalıpları, malın, sözün, isteklerin veya hakların bir kişiye bağlı çokluğunu bildirir.
Başka bir kişi kalıbı, kadın veya erkeğin çok konuştuğunu bildirir.
Edilgen yapı, kişiden iyilik isteyenlerin veya onun üzerindeki hakların çokluğunu bildirir.
Bir başka kalıp, kişinin başkasının malına dayanarak kendini çok malı varmış gibi göstermesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kalıba göre mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, iyilik isteyenlerin veya hak sahiplerinin çoğalması ve başkasının malıyla varlıklı görünme anlamlarını verir; bunlar ortak çokluk öğesine rağmen ayrı kullanımlardır. Bir açıklamada hakların çoğalmasına kişinin elindekinin tükenmesi eşlik eder.

concept_gloss.text: kişiye bağlı çokluk nitelemeleri
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız mal, konuşma, istem veya hak çokluğunu belirli kişi kalıplarında toplayan üst açıklama olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluk ortaklığını ve kullanımların kalıba bağlılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin varlığının ve malının çok olduğunu bildiren kişi kalıbında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yüklenen mal çokluğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadın veya erkek için sözün çokluğunu bildiren niteleme kalıbında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Konuşmanın çokluğu ve kişi niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kendisinden iyilik isteyenlerin veya üzerindeki hakların çok olduğu kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çok sayıda isteyen veya hak sahibinin kişiye yönelmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendisine ait olmayan mala dayanarak çok malı varmış gibi görünmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Malın başkasına ait oluşunu ve görünüş yaratmayı korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مكثر أو كاثر بمعنى كثير المال، ومكثار في كثرة الكلام، ومكثور عليه لكثرة طالبي المعروف أو الحقوق عليه، ويتكثر بمال غيره.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı sözlük birimini cennetteki özel ırmak, bol ve büyük iyilik, ayrıca iyiliği ve bağışı bol cömert önder için kullanır. Dal bu sözlüksel çokanlamlılık olarak korunabilir; bu üç gönderim tek bir varlık tanımıymış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Irmak, bol iyilik ve cömert kişi ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmelerdir; ortak bağları olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın bir çokluk anlamı kurmak yerine verilen sözcük ve kişi kalıbına bağlı üç özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Olağanüstü bolluk bildiren özel bir sözlük birimi, cennetteki bir ırmağı veya bol ve büyük iyiliği adlandırır; kişi kalıbında ise iyiliği ve bağışı bol, cömert bir önderi niteler.

facets.statement: Sözlük birimi cennette bulunan ve başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı özel bir ırmağı adlandırır.
Sözlük biriminin ortak çekirdeği, ırmak, iyilik ve kişi kullanımlarını olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesine bağlar.
Kişi kalıbında iyiliği ve bağışı çok, cömert ve önder bir erkek nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel sözlük birimini cennetteki bir ırmak ve bol ya da büyük iyilik olarak açıklar; kişi için kullanıldığında cömertliği, önderliği, iyilik ve bağış bolluğunu bildirir. Bir açıklamada cennet ırmaklarının çoğunun ondan ayrıldığı, bir diğerinde ise bol iyiliğin Peygamber'e verildiği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: özel ırmak veya bol iyilik
concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biriminin iki temel açıklamasını birlikte gösterir; kişi nitelemesi ayrıca bağlama bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel ırmak ile bol iyilik açıklamalarını ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı bildirilen cennet ırmağı anlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Irmak oluşunu ve cennete özgü gönderimi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birine verilmiş çok geniş ve büyük iyiliği anlatan açıklamada kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İyiliğin hem bolluğunu hem büyüklüğünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cömertliği, iyiliği ve çok bağışta bulunmasıyla öne çıkan erkek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin cömertliğini, önderliğini ve bağış bolluğunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yoğunlaşıp yükselen tozu adlandıran özel kullanımla bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildiren biçimi birlikte verir. Ortak aşırı çokluk bağı dalı korur, ancak toz görüntüsü genel çoğalma anlamının zorunlu parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toz kullanımı yükselme veya kabarma görüntüsüne bağlıdır; genel biçim ise yalnız aşırı derecede çoğalmayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, toza bağlı kalıbı ve genel aşırı çoğalma biçimini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar; toz özelliğini yalın çoğalma anlamına taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Toz kalıbında, çok olup kabaran veya havada belirgin biçimde yükselen yoğun tozu anlatır. Ayrı bir biçimde ise herhangi bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek olağanüstü çokluktur; toz kalıbında bu çokluk kabarıp havada yükselen yoğun bir görünüm alır.
Toz dışındaki bir şey için kullanılan biçim, onun aşırı ve son sınıra varan ölçüde çoğalmasını bildirir.
Ölüm sahnesindeki tozun kabarıp çoklaşması, yoğun toz kullanımına örnek oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çokluğu yüzünden kabarıp yükselen yoğun tozu ve bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını aynı aşırılık alanında birleştirir; kabaran ölüm tozu bu kullanıma örnek verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak ağırlığı hurma ağacının yenilebilir iç göbeğindedir; bazı açıklamalar bunu ağacın çekilen öz bölümü veya çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumu olarak genişletir. Dal korunabilir, fakat bu ikinci açıklama kesin eşdeğer gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel gönderim hurma ağacının iç göbeğidir; çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumu kaynaklarda verilen daha geniş bir açıklamadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bitki adını çekirdek alır; söz içindeki kullanım ve ağacın çiçeklenmesini bildiren biçim ayrı bağlı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Hurma ağacının tepe bölümündeki yumuşak ve yenilebilir iç göbeğini adlandırır; bazı açıklamalarda çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumuna da uzanır. Aynı birim belirli bir ceza sözünde meyveyle birlikte anılır.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, hurma ağacının tepesindeki yumuşak ve yenilebilir iç göbektir.
Bazı açıklamalar aynı adı hurmanın çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumuna da verir.
Bir ceza sözünde bu hurma ürünü, meyveyle birlikte el kesme cezasının uygulanmadığı şeyler arasında anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı çoğunlukla hurma ağacının iç göbeği ve çekilen öz bölümü için verir; bir açıklama çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumunu da kapsar ve yaygın bir sözde meyveyle birlikte anılır. Ad için kaynaklarda birden fazla harekeleme ve okunuş biçimi de aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: hurma ağacının iç göbeği

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin bir araya toplanması anlamını doğrudan verir ve sözcük yapısındaki ek sesin çokluk ailesiyle bağlantısını ayrıca belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız bir şeyin bir araya gelmesi anlamındadır; genel çokluk, hurma bölümü veya özel bolluk adlandırmaları buna katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtta verilen yalın sözlük biriminin bir araya toplanma anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve herhangi bir kalıp anlamı eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya öğelerinin bir araya gelerek toplanmasıdır; sözlük biriminin yapısındaki ek ses, bu anlamın çokluk ailesiyle bağlantısı olarak açıklanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin öğeleri bir araya gelir ve toplu duruma geçer.
Sözcük yapısındaki ek ses, birimin çokluk anlam ailesine bağlı oluşunu açıklamak için belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak, sözlük birimini bir şeyin bir araya toplanması diye açıklar ve yapısına eklenen m sesiyle birlikte onu çokluk anlam ailesine bağlar.
